_note: Review pass, November 2026: connections whose relationship turns, checked against the sources (each pair keeps its source).

edit.text: Adam Warlock attacks Knowhere on the High Evolutionary's orders and leaves Rocket mortally wounded.
edit.whoA: His target, whom he leaves mortally wounded.
edit.whoB: The attacker who leaves him mortally wounded.

add.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
add.text: After Adam saves Peter Quill's life, he joins the new Guardians of the Galaxy, with Rocket as their captain.
add.whoA: Captain of the new Guardians, the team he joins.
add.whoB: His former attacker, now on his new Guardians team.

pairs.source: Wikipedia, Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3 plot: "Quill nearly dies trying to reach Knowhere but is saved by Adam... names Rocket as the new captain... The new Guardians: Rocket, Groot, Kraglin, Cosmo, Adam, Phyla". Same-title turn, so the ally stage is added in the same title after the enemy one.

edit.text: Lash hunts Lincoln Campbell, believing he has an uncontrollable dark side, and attacks him at the hospital where he works. Later S.H.I.E.L.D. sends Lash to Hive's base in Lincoln's place, and Lash frees Daisy Johnson from Hive's control before he is killed.
edit.whoA: An Inhuman he hunts. Later he goes to Hive in his place.
edit.whoB: Lash, who hunts him, then goes to Hive in his place.

pairs.source: Wikipedia AoS S3 ep 20 'Emancipation': "this was a ruse on S.H.I.E.L.D.'s part, with Lash arriving instead of Lincoln. Lash uses his abilities to free Daisy from Hive's sway, but is killed by James." MCU Wiki: Lash, by then permanently a monster, was put on the Quinjet by May. They never really work together, so kind stays enemy; only the words are corrected.

edit.text: BB's gang holds a wounded Danny Rand hostage for a bounty, and Danny urges him to choose a better path. BB later turns on Davos, brings Danny and Colleen the bowl that can take back the Iron Fist, and is stabbed to death by fellow gang member Crank.
edit.whoA: The Iron Fist his gang holds hostage, whom he later helps.
edit.whoB: A gang kid who holds him hostage, then helps him against Davos.

pairs.source: Wikipedia Iron Fist S2 ep 5: "BB... is convinced by Rand to call Wing"; ep 8: "BB helps Joy steal the bowl"; ep 9: "BB faces his gang, and is killed." MCU Wiki BB: "BB showed them the bowl... Crank responded by stabbing BB multiple times." (The old whoB said Davos killed him; it was Crank.) Stage is tagged episode 9, by which BB is on Danny's side, so its kind becomes ally.

edit.text: Bill Foster works against Hope van Dyne to help Ghost, Ava Starr, cure herself with Janet's quantum energy.
edit.whoA: Hank's daughter, a foe while he helps Ghost.

pairs.source: MCU Wiki Bill Foster: "Foster attempted to stop Starr from extracting the energy, explaining that Pym could also be right about it killing Janet"; "Foster proceeded to escape from their Mobile Laboratory with Ava Starr and the rest of the group". Wikipedia AMATW: "Janet voluntarily gives some of her energy to Ava... Ava and Foster go into hiding". Same-title turn, added after the enemy stage.

edit.text: Calvin Zabo blames Phil Coulson for keeping his daughter Daisy from him and tries to kill him.
edit.whoA: The man he blames for keeping his daughter, and tries to kill.
edit.whoB: Daisy's father, who tries to kill him.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
add.text: Coulson talks a rampaging Cal down, and Cal joins his team to retake the Iliad, killing Jiaying to save Daisy. S.H.I.E.L.D. then wipes his memories so he can start a new life as a veterinarian.
add.whoA: The director who talks him down and gives him a new life.
add.whoB: Daisy's father, who helps him stop Jiaying.

pairs.source: Wikipedia AoS S2 'S.O.S.': "Coulson helps him see the truth: Jiaying is the true monster... Coulson, Fitz, and Cal infiltrate the ship... Jiaying begins draining her life until Cal kills Jiaying. S.H.I.E.L.D. later wipes Cal's memories, allowing him to live a new life in peace". MCU Wiki S.O.S. Part Two: "Zabo finally agrees to help Coulson and his team to stop Jiaying"; "becoming a veterinarian".

edit.text: Jorani, the Iron Fist, tackles the War Dog Ebo off his cart while searching for Basha and the stolen statue head, and he lures her into a room full of War Dogs.
edit.whoA: The Iron Fist, who tackles him off his cart.
edit.whoB: A War Dog she tackles off his cart, who sets guards on her.

add.title: Eyes of Wakanda
add.text: Once Jorani frees the vibranium from the statue for Basha, Ebo helps hide her break-in from Rakim and leads her back to the hangar so she can return to K'un-Lun with the statue head.
add.whoA: The Iron Fist he helps sneak home to K'un-Lun.
add.whoB: A War Dog who helps her get home to K'un-Lun.

pairs.source: Wikipedia Eyes of Wakanda ep 3 'Lost and Found': "He tricks the intruder into a cafeteria filled with Hatut Zaraze... Basha and Ebo cover up the incident to Rakim's satisfaction... Then they sneak Jorani back to the hangar so that she can return to K'un-Lun with the statue's head." MCU Wiki Jorani: "tackled him off his vehicle"; "followed the newly promoted Agent Ebo through an underground tunnel back to the hanger".

edit.text: Joseph Manfredi is the mob boss who helps Whitney Frost kidnap Jason Wilkes, and he nearly has Edwin Jarvis shot after Jarvis shoots Whitney.
edit.whoA: Whitney's mob boss, who nearly has him shot.
edit.whoB: Peggy's ally, whom he nearly has shot for shooting Whitney.

add.title: Agent Carter S2
add.text: Worried about what the Zero Matter is doing to Whitney, Manfredi comes to Howard Stark's estate and joins Jarvis, Peggy and Howard to stop her, drawing her away so Peggy can copy her plans.
add.whoA: Whitney's mob boss, who joins them to stop her.
add.whoB: Stark's butler, whom he joins to stop Whitney.

pairs.source: Wikipedia Agent Carter S2 ep 10 'Hollywood Ending': "Manfredi becomes concerned with Frost's behavior... He meets with Stark... and agrees to distract Frost while Carter and Sousa photograph the blueprints". MCU Wiki Manfredi (ep 8): "Manfredi gave the order... to shoot, Frost awoke and ordered them to stop"; (ep 10) "asking to work together to rid Frost of the Zero Matter".
